rationale: Price gapped up 4.2% on earnings beat but is now trading well below VWAP ($592.93) and has pulled back significantly from the session high ($605.61), sitting at only 34.9% of today's range — suggesting the initial gap enthusiasm has faded and sellers are in control mid-session. The wide bid-ask spread (39.3 bps) and the stock's position below VWAP make both long and short entries unattractive: a long faces overhead supply and VWAP resistance, while a short risks a mean-reversion bounce off the 9-EMA ($584.84) which price is currently testing. No clean directional edge is present.
